blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Human Resources is about people. It is the part of the company that finds, supports and develops employees.

When a company grows, it needs the right people in the right roles. That is where HR comes in. HR creates a plan that connects people to the goals of the business.

At Czarnikow, the HR team works with offices in London, Brazil and around the world. They make sure every employee has what they need to do their best work.

items.q: What is Human Resources about?
items.why: "Human Resources is about people."

items.q: What does HR create?
options: A plan that connects people to the goals
items.why: "HR creates a plan that connects people to the goals of the business."

items.q: Where does the Czarnikow HR team work?
items.why: "the HR team works with offices in London, Brazil and around the world."

items.q: The text suggests that HR is…
items.why: Inferência: "When a company grows, it needs the right people… That is where HR comes in." HR é importante para o crescimento.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: people are important for the business
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo mostra que as pessoas e o apoio a elas estão no centro do trabalho de RH.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie, a diretora de RH, na reunião com o CEO. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. Thank you for the time. Today I want to talk about our HR plan for next year.

Our business is growing. We have new projects in Brazil and in London. This is good news, but it means we need more people. We need the right people in the right roles.

My goal is simple. I want to hire ten new employees this year. Five for the London team and five for the Brazil team. I also want to support the people we already have. When we support our team, the team stays with us.

People are our most important resource. When our people are strong, the business is strong. So my plan and your business plan are the same plan.

I know this costs money. But good people help the company grow. This is not just a cost. It is a plan for the future. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie want to talk about?
options: The HR plan for next year
items.why: "Today I want to talk about our HR plan for next year."

items.q: How many new employees does Sophie want to hire?
items.why: "I want to hire ten new employees this year."

items.q: According to Sophie, what happens when the team feels supported?
options: The team stays with the company
The team moves to another city
items.why: "When we support our team, the team stays with us."

items.q: Sophie says her plan and the business plan are the same. This suggests that…
options: HR and the business have the same goal
items.why: Inferência: "my plan and your business plan are the same plan" — RH e negócio caminham juntos.

items.q: How does Sophie see the money spent on people?
options: As a problem for the CEO
As a plan for the future, not just a cost
items.why: Inferência: "This is not just a cost. It is a plan for the future."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our HR strategy helps the company win." A strategy is…
options: a plan to reach a goal
items.why: Strategy = estratégia: um plano para alcançar um objetivo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We want to ___ five new people for the London team."
items.why: To hire = contratar novas pessoas.

items.q: "Our main goal is to grow the business." A goal is…
options: a target you want to reach
items.why: Goal = meta, o alvo que você quer alcançar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good manager must ___ the team every day."
items.why: To support = apoiar, dar suporte à equipe.

items.q: "People are our most important resource." A resource is…
items.why: Resource = recurso: algo de valor que a empresa usa (aqui, as pessoas).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em reuniões de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CEO has to sign off on the new plan." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new plan next month." To roll out means to…
options: start it / put it in action
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, lançar.

items.q: "Sophie wants to work together with the CEO." To work together means to…
items.why: Work together = trabalhar em equipe, colaborar.

items.q: "HR helps the business grow." To grow means to…
items.why: To grow = crescer, ficar maior.

items.q: "The team agreed the plan, but did they follow through?" To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.
